title: Online Permutation Embedding: Optimal Stopping and Scaling Laws
summary: We study optimal online algorithms for embedding a permutation $π$ of $[k]$ into an iid stream of uniform $[0,1]$ random variables. This problem is a broad generalization of the classical online monotone subsequence selection problem, recovered in the special case $π=\mathrm{Id}_k$. Our first contribution is an efficiently solvable dynamic program for the optimal embedding time of any $k$-permutation $π$.
